meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪和管理长期目标进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在对话中持续跟踪多个长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Track and manage long-running goals persistently
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to persistently track and manage long-running goals in conversation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会用持久目标跟踪工具，帮你设置、检查、暂停、恢复或完成长期目标。创建目标时设定令牌预算；完成时会审计实际状态，确保所有要求满足才标记完成。
howto.when: 当你明确要求设置、继续、审计、暂停、恢复、完成或检查一个长期目标时，或者已有活跃目标时，Claude会启动这些工具。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新目标，目标是开发一个pip包，预算50000个token。
say.note: Claude会调用创建目标工具，记录目标和预算。

say.text: 查看当前活跃目标的进展。
say.note: Claude会调用检查目标工具，返回目标状态和进度。

say.text: 我认为目标已全部完成，请审计并标记完成。
say.note: Claude会执行审计流程，确认后调用完成更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses persistent goal tracking tools to help you set, inspect, pause, resume, or complete long-running goals. It creates goals with a token budget; before marking complete, it audits the actual state to ensure all requirements are met.
howto.when_en: When you explicitly ask to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists, Claude activates these tools.

say_en.text: Create a new goal to develop a pip package with a budget of 50000 tokens.
say_en.note: Claude calls the create goal tool with the objective and budget.

say_en.text: Check the progress of the current active goal.
say_en.note: Claude calls the inspect goal tool and returns status.

say_en.text: I believe the goal is fully done; please audit and mark it complete.
say_en.note: Claude performs audit and calls update goal if all conditions are met.
